# 24/7 Luxury Hotel & Apartment — Lekki, Lagos, Nigeria

> An Elevated Expression of Comfort & Luxury. 24/7 Hospitality, Boutique Hotel Suites & Serviced Apartments.

## Property Overview
24/7 Luxury Hotel & Apartment is a premier hospitality property situated in the prestigious Ikate Elegushi neighborhood of Lekki Peninsula II, Lagos, Nigeria. The property provides 24-hour uninterrupted electricity, armed round-the-clock security, an outdoor swimming pool, fully equipped fitness center, lotus wellness spa, 24/7 bistro restaurant & cocktail bar, and private chauffeur airport transfers.

## Location & Address
- Street: 39 Kusenla Road
- Neighborhood: Ikate Elegushi
- District: Lekki Peninsula II
- City: Lagos, Lagos State, Nigeria
- Landmark: Off Lekki-Epe Expressway, near Nike Art Gallery and Elegushi Royal Beach
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?q=39+Kusenla+Road+Ikate+Elegushi+Lekki+Lagos

## Accommodation & Rates (Nigerian Naira — NGN)

### Hotel Suites (Short-Stay Luxury)
1. **Standard Suite** — ₦50,000 / night
   - Capacity: 2 Adults, 1 Child | 32 m²
   - Bed: 1 Queen-size Orthopaedic Bed | View: Ikate City View
   - Key Features: 24/7 Power, High-Speed Fibre Wi-Fi, 43" Smart 4K TV, Rainfall Shower, Work Desk.

2. **Deluxe Suite** — ₦65,000 / night
   - Capacity: 2 Adults, 1 Child | 42 m²
   - Bed: 1 King-size Luxury Bed | View: Courtyard Pool View
   - Key Features: King Bed, Living Lounge Area, 50" Smart TV, Mini-refrigerator, Courtyard Pool View.

3. **Executive Suite** — ₦80,000 / night
   - Capacity: 2 Adults, 1 Child | 54 m²
   - Bed: 1 Super King-size Bed | View: Private Balcony / Lekki Horizon
   - Key Features: Private Step-out Balcony, Separate Parlour, Deep Soaking Tub + Rain Shower, Espresso Bar.

4. **Presidential Suite** — ₦120,000 / night
   - Capacity: 3 Adults, 2 Children | 78 m²
   - Bed: 1 Master California King Bed | View: Panoramic Lekki Skyline
   - Key Features: Private Hydro-massage Jacuzzi, 4-person Dining Area, Grand Living Lounge, Butler on Request.

### Serviced Apartments (Residential Living & Extended Stays)
1. **1-Bedroom Luxury Serviced Apartment** — ₦95,000 / night
   - Capacity: 2 Adults, 1 Child | 68 m²
   - Features: Fully equipped chef kitchen, private living room, dining nook, in-unit automatic washer/dryer, guest powder room.

2. **2-Bedroom Luxury Serviced Apartment** — ₦150,000 / night
   - Capacity: 4 Adults, 2 Children | 110 m²
   - Features: Two independent en-suite master bedrooms, 6-seat solid wood dining table, full chef kitchen, expansive lounge, private step-out balcony.

## Amenities & Facilities
- 24/7 Guaranteed Power (dual synchronised sound-proof generator setup with battery UPS backup)
- High-Speed Fibre Wi-Fi across all suites and grounds
- Outdoor Courtyard Swimming Pool with Cabanas & Poolside Service
- 24-Hour Bistro Restaurant & Cocktail Lounge serving Nigerian Classics and Continental Menus
- Lotus Wellness Spa (Deep tissue massages, aromatherapy, body scrubs, couples retreats)
- Equipped Fitness Center
- 24/7 Armed Security & CCTV Surveillance
- Secure Gated Parking with Valet
- Air-Conditioned Airport Transfers to/from Murtala Muhammed International Airport (LOS)

## Booking & Reservation Process
Guests may submit reservation requests directly online via the website booking portal or connect instantly with the 24/7 reservations team on WhatsApp (+234 906 000 0578). All bookings are verified by the reservations desk with flexible payment options including Bank Transfer and On-Arrival card settlement.
